readme.text:
**ArCowPelago** is an [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) implementation for Cow!

# Questions

## Cow?

[Cow!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4745980/Cow/)

## How?

[Setup guide.](./apworld/docs/setup_en.md)

## Why?

To spread knowledge about Cow.

> This game should be used as a model for the rest of the game industry"

\- Me to my friend while playing this game.

## DeathLink?

It's in the menu when you're connecting to the server.

## Contributing?

Sure! (But please no low-quality AI submissions)

## Feature Requests?

*Maybe*. This was meant to be a weekend project to add a silly game and learn Godot Modding.
It has already become much more than that, to my chagrin.
Any new features are going to have to be *really* funny to merit consideration.

notes.text:
## Additions

* Added support for ascended levels
* Added support for choosing a goal level
* Added deathlink counter

## Fixes

* Fixed an issue where clicking the ascended button would cause the level select screen to show vanilla progress
